description: Read, search and send in the owner's personal WhatsApp through wa, and link it. Use when a question could be answered from the owner's WhatsApp chats (what someone said, agreed, promised or sent, a document, a date, who owes a reply), when asked to find a WhatsApp chat, person or group, read or summarise a conversation, prepare for a meeting from chats, draft or send a reply, or link or connect WhatsApp.
